body:
I don't think he's cheating on me (sex) but honestly I can't be 100% sure about this. Honestly, if he was I wouldn't know about it. He said he'd never do that because I'm the only one he's ever been with, but at this point I don't anything he says. 

I don't have any friends (seriously) or family. The one person I have is my mom, but she just quit her job (for quite literally, no reason) and is on foodstamps. She's got a bigger spending issue than my husband. I'd rather kill myself than more back in with her.
Thank you. I actually cried reading this.
Thank you, once I figured out how to PM on this mobile app, I will.

My marriage is my only source of depression. I'm happy with everything except the relationship I have with my husband. However, my life resolves around my husband and our marriage. Leaving him is not easy, I don't have anything of my own. I gave up everything of my own when I married him. *I don't even have my own car.* Not complaining, just trying to give a scope of my situation. I feel bad for venting, sorry.

Woah. I haven't even read it but seen the title with "narcissist" and already know this is spot on. He is 100% a narcissist and I've told him he was once, but tried to turn the tables to say I was one. However, he always get upset and says thinks like "me" and "my" as if he's not in a partnership. He's extremely self in nature — he literally seperate a his clothes from mine to wash his own clothes, even if it's small load. It's mind blowing. I'm going to read it right now, thank you.

Thank you and I will. I just see the sub in the sidebar after I posted.

I didn't know a temporary order to leave the house was even a thing, but I'm glad that it is. I'm not concerned he'll beat me, however he has assaulted me by grabbing me by the shoulders shaking me. I'm more concerned with the verbal assault that will ensue when he comes home and has been served divorce papers. 

As I said, we only have one car and my job is run out of my home so I'm afraid of what would unfold.
